name: Tureen and cover
summary: Tableware in animal forms was first made in faience in factories such as Höchst and Strasbourg, in around 1750. These models were later imitated in China. The Dutch East India Company’s records list orders for 25 boar's head tureens in 1763, along with 25 goose-shaped tureens.
